project: PRAMAAN Multi-Modal Digital Forensic AI & Provenance Stack

release.note: Per-asset URLs may be overridden with PRAMAAN_<MODALITY>_WEIGHTS_URL; the tag with PRAMAAN_WEIGHTS_RELEASE_TAG.

image.architecture: Vision Transformer (vit_small_patch16_384.augreg_in21k_ft_in1k backbone with Linear(384, 1) head)
image.score_direction: Sigmoid activation on output logit -> higher value (approaching 1.0) represents manipulated/synthetic image.
image.validation_status: EMPIRICALLY TESTED. Evaluated on CommunityForensics DALL-E 2 test samples (manipulation scores 0.78-0.99) and genuine corpus images (scores < 0.02). Scores are uncalibrated model outputs, not probabilities of guilt.
image.known_limitations: Diffusion, GAN, and autoregressive synthetic image artifacts. Extreme heavy recompression or low resolution downsampling may alter texture representations.

audio.architecture: AASIST: Audio Anti-Spoofing using Integrated Spectro-Temporal Graph Attention Networks (RawNet2 Sinc-Conv + GAT)
audio.score_direction: Softmax output at index 0 represents probability of spoof / manipulated voice.
audio.validation_status: EMPIRICALLY TESTED. Official clovaai ASVspoof2019 LA pretrained checkpoint. Score is model output, not a calibrated legal probability.
audio.known_limitations: Optimized for speech anti-spoofing and cloned voice detection. Non-speech ambient audio and music fall outside training domain.

video.architecture: VideoMAEForVideoClassification (16-frame spatiotemporal tubelet transformer, 768 hidden size, 12 layers)
video.score_direction: Softmax output at index 1 represents probability of deepfake / manipulated video.
video.validation_status: EMPIRICALLY TESTED. VideoMAE transformer fine-tuned on FaceForensics++ video clips. Score is uncalibrated model output, not a probability.
video.known_limitations: Evaluates spatiotemporal consistency across 16 sampled frames. Extremely short videos with few frames require repeated padding.
